resources.string: The Glyph toy shows depth experiments with the hedgehog instead of the pet. Hold the Glyph button for the next one.
Tilt the phone: the curled-up hedgehog rolls and bounces off the edge; shake to throw it.
A voxel hedgehog turns left and right; tilting adds to the turn. Nearer is brighter.
Tilt slowly: stars and trees far away shift most, the hedgehog less, drops on the glass stay.
Three layers of snow fall along gravity and settle on its back; a shake brushes it off.
It hops every two seconds; the shadow shrinks and fades with height. Tilt to steer the hops.
Tilt left for the baby, right for the adult, upright for the teen.
It walks off to the horizon and back: adult near, teen, baby far and dim.
The Eye as a 3D sticker: tilt and it turns a little; the face cycles every 3 s (calm, happy, love, sad, asleep) and must stay readable.
The adult Planet is always a 3D sphere: bands turn, the ring and moon pass behind; tilt turns the view, the face cycles as in 8.
